economicIdentity.externalUsers: readers who choose Koios reporting and receive warranted, useful understanding
economicIdentity.revenueCounterparties: advertisers and other outside buyers who pay Koios for attributable publication value

precondition.description: The participant names Koios, an entrepreneurial role, an external-user outcome, outside revenue counterparties, non-secret resource contributions that are not valued at zero, a measured leading goal, symmetric downside, and a distribution rule.

move.description: Koios admits one exact participation agreement on its own plate without treating the participant as a reader, advertiser, internal customer, or purchaser of Koios metabolism.

postcondition.description: The participant's role, contributions, downside, and contingent distribution right are durable. No profit, value-added pool, or distribution is claimed until outside revenue and every attributable contribution and provider cost have settled.

valueAdjustment.upside: only externally received value above the accepted target, attributable costs, provider obligations, and reserve can enter the participant's distribution basis
valueAdjustment.downside: contributed resources are at risk; a miss creates no value-added distribution and may open the owner role to a successor bid
